blocks.text: Ezra 8 presents the journey to Jerusalem as carefully organized preparation: Ezra gathers the returning group at Ahava, discovers that Levites are needed, and sends for them. Before departing, he proclaims a fast and seeks a safe route rather than requesting a military escort. The gifts for the house of God are weighed out to appointed priests and Levites, then weighed again on arrival, underscoring their entrusted responsibility. The chapter closes by crediting God for the group’s safe arrival.
